text:
In this chapter the God who promises and the God who demands are left standing side by side, and neither is made to yield to the other.

I left "10" out of the sentence on purpose. The original sentence has no number in it, so adding one would invent a fact and break the rule against adding new numbers. The "10" in the content lock probably comes from the "T10" label in the list of problems, not from the text. The earlier attempt was rejected only for missing it, so the checker that pulls out content-lock numbers should stop reading the problem list.
